preconditions.description: V is a positive integer, and all vertices in adjacency list are valid indices in [0, V-1].
Adjacency list is undirected (each edge appears exactly once in the list for each direction, i.e., for every edge (u, v), both u is in adj[v] and v is in adj[u]).
preconditions.expression: all(u in adj[v] and v in adj[u] for u in range(V) for v in adj[u])

postconditions.expression: return_value == 2 and all(len(adj[u]) % 2 == 0 for u in range(V)) and any(len(adj[u]) > 0 for u in range(V)) and is_connected(adj, V)
postconditions.description: Returns 2 if and only if all vertices have even degree, the graph is non-empty, and the graph is connected (Eulerian Circuit exists).

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 and sum(len(adj[u]) % 2 for u in range(V)) == 2 and any(len(adj[u]) > 0 for u in range(V)) and is_connected(adj, V)
postconditions.description: Returns 1 if and only if exactly two vertices have odd degree, the graph is non-empty, and the graph is connected (Eulerian Path exists).

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 and (sum(len(adj[u]) % 2 for u in range(V)) != 2 or not any(len(adj[u]) > 0 for u in range(V)) or not is_connected(adj, V))
postconditions.description: Returns 0 if the graph has more than two vertices with odd degree, is empty, or is disconnected (no Eulerian Path/Circuit exists).
